# The Poor Traveler

> > Budget travel guides, itineraries, and practical tips for exploring the Philippines and Asia without breaking the bank.

The Poor Traveler is a comprehensive travel resource specializing in budget-friendly travel throughout the Philippines and popular Asian destinations including Japan, Korea, Thailand, and the Maldives. The site features detailed DIY itineraries, transportation guides, accommodation reviews, and practical travel tips with transparent pricing and booking information.

## Key Topics

- Budget Travel
- Philippines Travel
- DIY Itineraries
- Metro Manila
- Japan Travel
- Seoul & Korea
- Bangkok & Thailand
- Beach Destinations
- Island Hopping
- AirAsia
- Traveloka
- COVID-19 Travel Guidelines
- Transportation Guides
- Hotel & Hostel Reviews
- Travel Planning Apps

## Philippines Destination Guides

- [ANAWANGIN COVE: Travel Guide & Budget Itinerary](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2018/03/anawangin-cove): DIY travel guide for Anawangin Cove, Zambales with budget itinerary
- [CORREGIDOR DAY TOUR: 12 Historic Sites to Visit](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2014/07/manila-corregidor-island-tour-rates-attractions): Guide to Corregidor day tour covering 12 historic WWII military sites
- [SPIN Designer Hostel El Nido: Our Best Hostel Experience in Palawan](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2015/11/best-spin-designer-hostel-where-to-stay-in-el-nido-palawan-philippines): Review of SPIN Designer Hostel accommodation in El Nido, Palawan
- [You're My Boss: 10 Filming Locations in Batanes](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2015/04/youre-my-boss-shooting-locations-batanes): Guide to 10 Batanes filming locations from You're My Boss movie

## Transportation & Travel Logistics

- [JAC LINER BUS: Open Terminals, Schedule, Routes, Stops & Fare (New Normal)](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/jac-liner-bus-schedule-terminal): JAC Liner bus schedules, routes, terminals and fares for Laguna routes
- [FUKUOKA AIRPORT to HAKATA STATION & TENJIN: By Bus, Subway & Taxi](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2018/11/fukuoka-airport-to-hakata-station-tenjin-by-bus-subway-taxi): Transport guide from Fukuoka Airport to Hakata Station and Tenjin
- [How to Get to Boryeong from Seoul or Incheon Airport](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2016/08/boryeong-daecheon-beach-seoul-incheon-airport-directions-bus-train): Transportation guide to Boryeong and Daecheon Beach from Seoul/Incheon

## COVID-19 Travel Updates & Guidelines

- [Canceled AIRASIA Flight due to COVID-19? Here's How to REBOOK or REFUND!](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2020/03/rebooking-airasia-flight): Guide to rebooking or refunding canceled AirAsia flights during COVID-19
- [CLARK AIRPORT: Travel Requirements & Guidelines for Arriving AirAsia Passengers](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2020/07/clark-airport-requirements): Clark Airport COVID-19 travel requirements for AirAsia passengers

## Travel Apps & Booking Tools

- [4 Features that Make Traveloka a Budget Traveler's Best Friend](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2018/04/traveloka-app-budget-planning): Review of Traveloka app features for budget travel planning and booking
- [BPI to PAYMAYA: How to Add Money Using PayMaya App](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/bpi-to-paymaya): Tutorial for transferring money from BPI to PayMaya digital wallet

- [California: 5 Ways to Make Your Trip More Special](https://www.thepoortraveler.net/2017/01/california-5-ways-make-trip-special): Travel tips for making California road trips special with hidden gems
